title: Attained probability-space potential-field formula for convex stochastic homogenization with minimal diagonal-weight moments
difficulty_reason: H2: after reusing old2149 Gamma homogenization, weak-L1 weight control and measurable cell minimizers, and allowing named ergodic, selection and convex-analysis tools, the author still identifies the spatial cell limit with an attained minimum over zero-mean L1 potential fields. A stationary potential realization is adjusted to have zero average gradient, and the degenerately weighted local Lipschitz estimate controls the resulting energy error using only the minimal moments. Conversely, jointly measurable finite-cell gradients are zero-extended and translated/averaged into an integrable zero-mean field; the explicit distributional change of variables preserves row-wise curl-freeness before Jensen, stationarity and the L1 subadditive limit close the reverse inequality. This concrete two-way admissibility and energy construction supports one H2 beyond the old Gamma result. Direct-method existence, strict-convexity inheritance, differentiability via BKK/FoLe and PDE minimizer convergence are retained inputs/consumers, not separate H3 components.
